note: PROVISIONAL RULES, SWAPPABLE. Periodic-report deadlines (v2.3.0, plan B5; made a swappable pack in v2.4.0). Each rule names its source; 'verified' records how it was checked. The rules are applied provisionally until the author confirms the final text; results say so.
how_to_update: SWAPPABLE MODULE. This pack can be replaced without a new version of the program: 'ashare-cli rules-export deadlines' copies it to the data folder's rules folder for editing; 'ashare-cli rules-import deadlines FILE --apply' installs an edited copy after checking it (the pack it replaces is kept in rules/_replaced); 'ashare-cli rules-reset deadlines --apply' returns to the pack shipped with the program. The same actions are under Check > Rules. Set a rule's 'status' to 'confirmed' once its article, effective date and numbers have been checked against the official text, and record the check in 'verified'; 'withdrawn' keeps a rule without applying it.
